series.nom: Ventes d'épicerie en ligne aux États-Unis

Juin 2025.texte: U.S. online grocery sales totaled $9.8 billion for June 2025, a 27.6% increase

Juillet 2025.texte: U.S. online grocery sales totaled $10.0 billion for July 2025, a 26.0% increase from the prior year

Septembre 2025.texte: U.S. online grocery sales surged to a new high of $12.5 billion in September 2025, marking a 31% increase

Décembre 2025.texte: total sales surging 32% year-over-year (YOY) to finish the month with a record high $12.7 billion
